offers.sn: Driving the transition to autonomous mobility: Our mission is to spearhead the deployment of Level 4 autonomous systems in Germany and beyond.
offers.rq: A completed degree in computer science, robotics, engineering, applied mathematics, or a comparable field - or equivalent vocational training/apprenticeship in a relevant technical discipline. 3+ years of experience in motion planning, robotics, or autonomous vehicle software English C1 is required; German is a plus
